title: tune-nccl-overlap-kvcache-continuous-batching-tensor-parallel
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: reduce multi-GPU tensor-parallel tail latency and increase sustained throughput for long-context workloads by improving overlap between NCCL collectives and local kernel execution, and by adapting KV-cache continuous-batching behaviour for TP sharded KV stores. Summary: introduce prioritized NCCL stream scheduling, fine-tune NCCL communicator attributes, add kernel-side lightweight yield points to allow asynchronous collectives to progress, and adapt the KV-cache continuous-batching window and prefetch heuristics when running in tensor parallel mode. The change touches the runtime scheduler, NCCL init/path selection, kv-cache sharding logic, and batching controller. Expected impact: 8-18% throughput uplift in TP microbenchmarks, 10-25% reduction in p95 token latency for 8/16 GPU shards under mixed request sizes. This PR also adds a small compat shim for older NCCL versions and a fallback to safe synchronous collectives when async progress is unavailable. Related: ENG-1842 (TP collectives roadmap), ENG-1904 (kv-cache batching improvements); follows up on several prior PRs tuning streams and kernels (see references in commits).
commits: Ava Martinez: prioritize-nccl-streams-and-add-yield-points - Introduce stream priority and light kernel yields to improve overlap
Ravi Patel: kvcache-batching-adjustments-tp - Adjust continuous-batching window & prefetch heuristics for TP sharded KV cache
Lena Hoffmann: nccl-attr-fallback - Add compatibility/path selection for older NCCL builds and fallbacks
changed_snippets: // runtime/nccl/comm_manager.cc: ncclCommInitRank(..., ncclComm_t* comm) with ncclCommSetAttr(comm, NCCL_COMM_ATTR_ASYNC_PROGRESS, 1)
// runtime/kv_cache/sharded_kvcache.cc: if (tensor_parallel_mode) { continuous_batch_window = max(continuous_batch_window / 2, min_window); prefetch_threshold = prefetch_threshold * 0.75; }
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Can we add a guard to skip async progress on known-broken NCCL versions? - author: added version check and fallback in nccl/path_selection.cc
Lena Hoffmann: Benchmarks look promising; please add perf regression CI job to validate across 8/16 GPU nodes - author: added ci/perf/regression_config.yaml and a nightly job
Diego Alvarez: Suggest reducing default continuous-batch window for TP to avoid excessive KV prefetching on inference-heavy workloads - author: tuned defaults and exposed config knob for ops teams
benchmarks: 8-GPU TP, open prompt mix: throughput +12% median, p95 -14%
16-GPU TP, long-context 32k tokens: throughput +9% median, p95 -18%
Mixed-size steady state with continuous batching: token/s +8-18% depending on batch shaping
release_notes: Performance: improved NCCL overlap scheduling and KV-cache continuous-batching defaults for tensor-parallel workloads; Behavior: safer fallback for older NCCL builds; Operator notes: new runtime flags net.runtime.nccl.async_progress_enabled and net.runtime.kvcache.tp_batch_window for tuning in deployment.
